notes.title: The DEMO is coming for Steam Next Fest October 2023!
notes.content:
[h1]Get ready for an epic goblin invasion at Steam Next Fest![/h1]

It's time to put your spears and arrows to the test because [b]Age of Goblins[/b] is about to storm Steam Next Fest in October 2023! Our small (but terribly mischievous) friends are eager to emerge from the shadows and invade your PC for the first time.

[h2]Don't miss the opportunity to try it out![/h2]
We're excited to announce that starting from the next Steam Next Fest, you'll be able to test Age of Goblins with a free demo! We intend to keep the demo available indefinitely, so don't miss the chance, as we don't know when we'll have to remove it.

[h2]We want to hear from you![/h2]
Enjoy yourselves to your heart's content and then share with us in the Community section what you thought of the experience. We want to hear your feedback and implement improvements.

[h2]See you soon![/h2]
We hope to see you at Steam Next Fest!
And as the goblin leader Rkhan'Rhun would say: "[i]- Rhakrtai rhatkaan, rhan![/i]" (um, but I never really understood what that means...)
